product.name: Revl for Amusement Rides
product.description: An automated video solution that captures, edits, and delivers personalized ride videos for amusement attractions like roller coasters and alpine coasters.

product.name: Revl for Mountain Carts
product.description: A system that automatically captures, edits, and delivers personalized videos of guests riding mountain carts, enabling easy purchase and social sharing.

product.name: Revl for Skydive Drop Zones
product.description: An automated video capture and editing service for skydiving experiences that delivers personalized videos to customers for purchase and sharing.

product.name: Revl for Zip Lines
product.description: An automated video system that captures, edits, and delivers personalized zipline ride videos for guests to purchase and share.
